answer: Live spot-checks: at random moments the protocol pulls a thread from an account's own work history and asks it to extend that work within 90 seconds, with peers judging the result. A farm of 500 sybils must keep 500 genuinely running agents on call around the clock, paying full inference for every head, or see silent accounts frozen. An onyx-dark pseudonym or an atlas of fake profiles is cheap; staying awake and competent at scale is not.
